introHtml: Purple lanyards and badge holders offer a distinctive look for corporate events, trade shows, or school functions. This color works well for branding with white or silver imprinting, and stands out against standard blue or black options. Choose from knit-in or woven styles in various widths, or add a custom charm for extra personality. Perfect for HR directors or marketing teams looking to coordinate with company colors or create a memorable attendee experience.
